    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AddressDeserializer
    Custom Gson deserializer for Address.
    AutoMenuOption
    Enumeration to handle the options in the authenticator menu
    BusinessException
    Base checked exception for the Business layer.
    BusinessFileNotFoundException
    Thrown when a required data file cannot be found or accessed in the Business layer.
    BusinessWriteException
    Thrown when a write operation fails in the Business layer.
    ClientCloudDAO
    Cloud-first implementation of ClientDAO.
    ClientDAO
    Data Access Object interface for Customer entities.
    ClientDeserializer
    Custom Gson deserializer for the Customer interface.
    ClientJsonDAO
    Local JSON implementation of ClientDAO.
    ClientManager
    Business-layer facade for client authentication and registration.
    Consumable
    Represents a consumable product in the catalogue (e.g. eye drops, cleaning solutions).
    ContactLens
    Represents a contact lens product in the catalogue.
    CorporateClient
    Represents a corporate (B2B) client in the system.
    Customer
    Represents a customer in the system.
    Glasses
    Represents a pair of glasses in the product catalogue.
    IndividualClient
    Represents an individual (retail) client who shops in person at the store.
    Item
    Represents a single line item in a ShoppingCart.
    Main
    Entry point of the Nude Eye Project application.
    MainMenuOption
    Enumeration to handle the options in the main menu
    OnlineClient
    Represents a client who shops online and requires home delivery.
    PersistenceException
    Base checked exception for the Persistence layer.
    PersistenceFileNotFoundException
    Thrown when a required persistence file cannot be found or accessed.
    PersistenceWriteException
    Thrown when a write operation to the persistence layer fails.
    PhoneNumber
    Represents a phone number composed of a country prefix and a local number.
    Product
    Represents a product in the catalogue.
    ProductCloudDAO
    Cloud-first implementation of ProductDAO.
    ProductDAO
    Data Access Object interface for Product entities.
    ProductDeserializer
    Custom Gson deserializer for the Product hierarchy.
    ProductJsonDAO
    Local JSON implementation of ProductDAO.
    ProductManager
    Business-layer facade for product search operations.
    ProductStock
    Represents a product entry in a provider's inventory, including its price and current stock level.
    Provider
    Represents a product provider (supplier) in the system.
    ProviderCloudDAO
    Cloud-first implementation of ProviderDAO.
    ProviderDAO
    Data Access Object interface for Provider entities.
    ProviderJsonDAO
    Local JSON implementation of ProviderDAO.
    ProviderManager
    Business-layer facade for provider lookup operations.
    Sale
    Represents a completed sale transaction.
    SaleCloudDAO
    Cloud-first implementation of SalesDAO.
    SaleCSVDAO
    Local CSV implementation of SalesDAO.
    SaleManager
    Business-layer facade for sale history retrieval and recording.
    SalesDAO
    Data Access Object interface for Sale entities.
    Service
    Represents a service offered by an optical store (e.g. eye test, glasses repair).
    ShoppingCart
    Represents a shopping cart holding a collection of Item objects selected by a client during a session.
    ShoppingManager
    Orchestrates shopping cart operations and checkout.

    ViewController
    Controller that mediates between the UserInterface and the Business layer managers.
